_doc: Adventure-map object sprites for the catalogue in docs/design/CONTENT_MAP_OBJECTS.md (docs/art/classes/map-objects.md). generate-image-v2 at native display size: 1x1 sites on 64x64, small pickups on 40x40, 2x2 sites on 128x128, the 3x2 vault on 200x152; one call returns several candidates. Layers: style, light-south-west, class-map-object, subject; the imported sawmill is the style image for outline, pixel size and viewing angle only. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

styleSawmill.usage: copy only the thick black outline, the pixel size, the flat shading with one shadow tone and the slightly-from-above front viewing angle; not the subject, not the colours and not the layout

recipes.subject: Subject: a sturdy countryside windmill: a round tapering tower of pale whitewashed stone #e4dccb with #a99f8c shadows, a pointed cap of red clay tiles #c0503a with #82321f shadows, four big crossed sails of brown timber frames #8a5a2c with cream canvas #efe3c2, a small arched wooden door at the front left of the base, and two flour sacks beside it. The windmill fills most of the image height and about two thirds of its width.
recipes.negative: flag, banner, water, river, fence, farmer
